title: 7-Day Declutter Challenge
subtitle: One small space a day, with a clear finish line.
purpose: Make room gradually by focusing on manageable categories instead of an entire home.
fields: A space I want to enjoy
instructions: Set a timer that feels manageable; stopping on time is part of the challenge.
Use the suggested area as a starting point and skip anything unsafe or sentimental.
Move donations and recycling out of the home promptly when you can.
tasks: Remove 10 items that do not belong here.
Keep what fits and is worn; set aside the rest.
Discard expired items according to local guidance.
Recycle duplicates and file the next useful action.
Clear one surface and return only daily essentials.
Delete obvious duplicates and old screenshots.
Finish one bag and choose its next destination.
